title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
venue: Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics, PMLR 15:627-635
read_scope: Official proceedings metadata and abstract; foundational scope checked, proof and full algorithm not reread in this pass.
method_overlap: Learning on the state distribution induced by one's own sequential policy is established; essential baseline for learner-state aggregation in TTA selection.
limitation: Imitation learning generally; not a vision-TTA benchmark or matched empirical baseline without an explicit adaptation.

title: Detecting and Correcting for Label Shift with Black Box Predictors
venue: Proceedings of the 35th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 80:3122-3130
read_scope: Official metadata/abstract and visible official PDF introduction on estimator assumptions; partial reading.
method_overlap: Estimates target class priors from unlabeled predictions and labeled source confusion statistics; detects and corrects pure label shift.
limitation: Requires invariant class-conditionals and invertible confusion matrix; simultaneous nuisance shifts can invalidate its source confusion statistics.

title: Leveraging Unlabeled Data to Predict Out-of-Distribution Performance
read_scope: arXiv metadata/abstract; official ICLR Downloads listing; primary paper §3.1 and ATC discussion via author/institutional PDF. Partial reading.
method_overlap: Source-calibrated confidence threshold estimates unlabeled target accuracy; impossibility result blocks arbitrary-shift accuracy identification.
limitation: Requires labeled source validation; empirical target transfer of confidence/error relation is conditional and can fail. Accuracy estimation is distinct from selecting an intervention before adaptation.
publication_status: ICLR 2022 official program listing and paper header verified; arXiv v3 revised 15 October 2022

title: DELTA: Degradation-Free Fully Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: Official ICLR listing/paper header, arXiv metadata and HTML §§1, 3.1-3.3; partial reading.
method_overlap: Test-time batch renormalization and dynamic reweighting address correlated/imbalanced-stream moment errors and biased self-learning.
limitation: Prediction-frequency estimates combine true class skew and model bias; its empirical degradation-free title is not an unrestricted safety guarantee. Full results not audited here.
publication_status: ICLR 2023 official listing and PDF header verified

title: Label Shift Adapter for Test-Time Adaptation under Covariate and Label Shifts
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision, pages 16375-16385
read_scope: arXiv title/authors/abstract; official CVF PDF §5 and conclusion visible in primary index; partial reading.
method_overlap: Estimates target label distribution and generates adaptation parameters conditional on it, integrating with existing TTA objectives.
limitation: Additional source-stage adapter training; paper notes normalization hyperparameter sensitivity. Source and target imbalance adaptation already part of scope.
publication_status: ICCV 2023 official paper; linked arXiv preprint 2308.08810

title: Beyond Invariance: Test-Time Label-Shift Adaptation for Addressing "Spurious" Correlations
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
read_scope: Official NeurIPS metadata and abstract; not a full-method read.
method_overlap: Uses unlabeled EM to adapt joint class/nuisance priors through a discriminative source model.
limitation: Source group metadata and invariant p(x|y,z) assumption; not arbitrary causal shift identification or generic weights-only TTA.

title: Towards Real-World Test-Time Adaptation: Tri-Net Self-Training with Balanced Normalization
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 38(13)
read_scope: Official AAAI metadata and abstract; arXiv v2 protocol and methodology sections inspected. Partial reading; version revised March 2025.
method_overlap: Combines global/local class imbalance and continual shifts; balances category-wise moments and anchors self-training.
limitation: Predicted category estimates and teacher reliability remain consequential. Not a no-label guarantee of real class mixture or a pre-action whole-method selector.
publication_status: AAAI 2024 proceedings verified; linked arXiv v2 updated 26 March 2025

title: Channel-Selective Normalization for Label-Shift Robust Test-Time Adaptation
venue: Proceedings of The 3rd Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents, PMLR 274:514-533
read_scope: Official metadata and downloaded official PDF §§3-5, Algorithms 1-2, selected result descriptions; partial reading.
method_overlap: Source-labeled class/channel sensitivity scores; uniform-prior adaptation pass followed by pseudolabel-based prior rescoring. Direct predecessor for selective normalization under combined covariate/label shift.
limitation: BN networks and labeled-source post-training preparation; offline single-batch setting with batch500 for CIFAR/ImageNet rather than a learned closed-loop persistent selector.
publication_status: PMLR publication 2025; PDF footer identifies CoLLAs 2024. Preserve existing citation key and distinguish event/publication year.

title: Monitoring Risks in Test-Time Adaptation
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
read_scope: Official NeurIPS metadata; arXiv v2 Assumption1, Proposition1, §§5.2-5.4, §6 and AppendixA.5. Partial reading.
method_overlap: Label-free sequential risk lower bounds for adapting models, conditional on calibrated proxy informativeness; alternative proxies and explicit prior-shift experiment.
limitation: Assumption verification needs target labels. A lower risk bound crossing detects excess risk; staying below threshold does not certify safety. Paper explicitly leaves unlabeled assumption diagnostics open.
publication_status: NeurIPS 2025 main conference verified; earlier workshop versions must not be confused with full version

title: Test-Time Adaptation by Causal Trimming
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
read_scope: Official metadata and author repository overview; arXiv methods/theoretical scope and conclusion, selected appendix directions. Partial reading.
method_overlap: Controlled augmentations, PCA nuisance directions, trimming representations and prototypes; a gradient-updating variant also described.
limitation: Requires prior knowledge for causal-content-preserving augmentations; PCA separation assumptions and view generation cost. Sensitivity under a transform does not establish physical shift causality.

title: Logit-Adjusted Test-Time Adaptation under Partial Class Imbalance
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision, pages 5977-5985
read_scope: Official CVF/IEEE metadata, abstract, visible official PDF §3 drift argument and supplemental simplified derivation. Partial reading; later direct PDF fetch returned403.
method_overlap: Long-term partial-class TTA, BN beta drift, target-prior logit adjustment and evaluations on CIFAR100-C/ImageNet-C/DomainNet126.
limitation: Specific partial-class setting and simplified drift analysis; neither arbitrary cause inference nor pre-action whole-method safety guarantee. Full experiments not audited.
publication_status: WACV2026 official proceedings and IEEE DOI verified

title: Calibration-Aware Online Adaptation under Label Shift
venue: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 337:2480-2516
read_scope: Official PMLR metadata/abstract and official accepted-paper page. Not full method or proof read.
method_overlap: Separately calibrated auxiliary classifier estimates streaming target priors; analyzes calibration-dependent estimation error and calibration-granularity tradeoff.
limitation: Label-shift setting; no arbitrary simultaneous nuisance-shift guarantee established by the inspected abstract.
publication_status: UAI2026 official proceedings and accepted list verified

title: On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective
venue: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:166172-166195
read_scope: Official PMLR metadata; arXiv v2 §§2-4 assumptions/definitions, §7 limitations, selected proof discussion. Partial reading; no proof verification.
method_overlap: Recovery complexity, learnability, dynamic regret, effective batch size under dependence and proxy/task alignment.
limitation: Structural assumptions on proxy alignment and losses; not guarantees for arbitrary deep entropy adaptation. Paper leaves comprehensive empirical/large-scale study to future work.

title: Multi-Hypothesis Test-Time Adaptation to Mitigate Underspecification
read_scope: arXiv metadata/abstract, §§3-4 and appendicesH-I; partial reading.
method_overlap: Population-based diversification of output, parameters, optimizer and inputs creates multiple adaptation hypotheses; mixed-shift, small-batch and label-shift evaluation.
limitation: Runtime grows roughly with particle count; reported gains are author results, not independent evidence that this wrapper dominates all protocols.
publication_status: arXiv v1 submitted30June2026; no independently verified venue

title: The Premise Is the Problem: Exchangeability Failure in Self-Monitored Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: arXiv metadata/abstract, introduction and selected discussion of feedback, dependence and evaluation limits; partial reading of a49-page paper.
method_overlap: Self-monitoring feedback can hide sustained shifts or produce invalid alarms; frozen source can retain a clearer signal.
limitation: Multi-step time-series forecasting with revealed forecast outcomes; not strictly unlabeled visual classification or a verified universal monitor impossibility theorem.
publication_status: arXiv v1 submitted4October2026; no independently verified venue

title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
read_scope: Metadata, introduction, §2.2.2, execution-harness descriptions and AppendixE limitations. Partial reading.
method_overlap: Learned state-conditioned method selection with same-snapshot local counterfactuals; explicitly identifies gold-history/autonomous-history exposure bias and leaves autonomous-stream credit assignment open.
limitation: Isolated LoRA skill library over frozen LLM, gold-generated training successor states and query-level reward; benefit-enriched benchmark. Not a continual shared-weights visual TTA evaluation.
publication_status: arXiv v1 submitted8October2026; no independently verified venue
